packageDirectories.versionName: v3.3.0 — CMDT-generated prompt schema for supported wire keys
packageDirectories.versionDescription: Résumé Parser full app: data model, Apex, wizard LWC + custom Lightning type, GenAI prompt template, flows, GenAiFunction, a single Resume_Parser_User permission set, layouts. v3.2.1 makes the agent publishable on current Agentforce: the resolved Contact Id is passed inside the wizard's Details JSON (the dedicated action-input approach could not publish — the genAiFunction only surfaces Details), and the now-unused contactId plumbing is removed from the flow/ResumeWizardData. Keeps the v3.2.0 read-only 'How fields map' disclosure and the v3.1.0 data-driven Resume_Field_Map__mdt field map. v3.3.0 generates the prompt schema for supported typed candidate/role wire keys from active Resume_Field_Map__mdt rows and injects it via ExtraInstructions; existing keys can be retargeted or tuned in CMDT, while brand-new keys still require Apex DTO and LWC support. It also removes temporary Draft/files after parse failure or Re-upload and activates the exact agent version published without editing generated planner metadata. NOTE: 04tHu000004hhiJIAQ (3.2.1-1) remains the last BUILT/Released package; this 3.3.0 source is not yet packaged.
